newsitem.title: GERMANY: German union holds limited UPS protest.
newsitem.headline: German union holds limited UPS protest.

text.p: The German transport union OeTV held the first in a series of limited protests on Monday in support of the Teamsters' strike at United Parcel Service of America Inc in the U.S., a union source said.
The union distributed leaflets and organised a meeting at a UPS depot in Frankfurt, an OeTV spokeswoman told Reuters.
She said further protests were planned for this week but declined to give any further details and was unable to indicate the level of support at the Frankfurt site.
In an earlier statement, OeTV deputy chairman Wolfgang Warburg said: "The UPS management in Germany and the U.S. must know that we support the strikers on the other side of the Atlantic.

"The employees in Germany are protected by our wages contracts. But what the UPS head office in Atlanta wants to implement in the U.S. today will be on the negotiating table in Germany tomorrow," he added.
The OeTV said it was particularly concerned at the growth in sub-contracting by UPS which was putting staff under additional pressure.
